chapter_seo_title: Scholar Lü's High Life: Feasting, Bragging, and Walking Into a Trap
chapter_meta_description: Lu Xiucai swaggers through Yinling City on a new wave of status—feasts, brothels, and sycophants—until a gang boss offers him an eighty-percent cut on a cursed job.
og_title: Scholar Lü's High Life: Donkey Dumplings, Fake Stories, and a Cursed Job Offer
og_description: Lu Xiucai is living his best life in Yinling City—but every swaggering step brings him closer to a trap he can't see coming.
twitter_title: Lu Xiucai's new life: feasts, brothels, and a gang boss with a cursed problem.
twitter_description: The former beggar-performer is drunk on status and blind to the trap Kui Sanjin is setting. A character study in how fast a survivor turns petty tyrant.

lore_anchors.definition: A restaurant name common in xianxia settings; "Drunken Immortal" suggests a place where even celestials could be tempted by mortal wine.
A euphemism for a red-light district; historically, pleasure houses in such areas often bundled food or "companion services" with a room.
A local gang boss in Yinling City; his hand tattoos and ability to bypass the city's rental restrictions mark him as a man of local power and dirty connections.
A city-wide restriction on movement after dark; in this world, violating curfew can mean arrest or worse, making it a practical constraint on any nighttime scheme.

cultural_notes_faq.a: No. Most of it is stolen from Gouwa; Lu just replaces himself as the hero.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Kui Sanjin offer eighty percent?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In the Dao-Twisted World, suspiciously high offers always come with hidden costs. The curse is almost certainly far worse than Kui admits, or the fix will require a sacrifice Lu can't imagine.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Lu Xiucai treat Tao'er so badly?
cultural_notes_faq.a: His rapid social ascent has given him a cruel sense of entitlement. He sees her as a possession, not a person, because he bought her and because he now believes he deserves more than a "plain" woman.
